title: Clardona, Baybush, Straffan, Co. Kildare., W23 RR02
seoTitle: Clardona, Baybush, Straffan, Co. Kildare., W23 RR02
description:
A rare opportunity to acquire a substantial family home on a magnificent c.1 acre site in one of Kildare's most sought-after locations.

Nestled amidst beautifully mature gardens and approached by a sweeping driveway, Clardona offers the perfect blend of space, privacy and potential. This attractive brick-built dormer residence enjoys a peaceful countryside setting while remaining within easy reach of every modern convenience.

The property provides generous and versatile accommodation, including four spacious bedrooms, a bright open-plan kitchen/living area, utility room, shower room and a comfortable sitting room at ground floor level. Upstairs, accessed via a spiral staircase, are three further large rooms and a bathroom, offering exceptional flexibility and endless possibilities.

Outside, the true appeal of Clardona becomes evident. The exceptional c.1 acre site is surrounded by mature landscaped gardens, creating a private sanctuary for family life, outdoor entertaining and relaxation. There is ample parking, a useful fuel/tool shed and extensive space for future enhancement, making this an ideal home for growing families and those seeking a superior lifestyle in a beautiful setting.

Location is everything, and Clardona excels in this regard. Ideally positioned in the highly regarded village of Straffan, home to the world-renowned K Club Resort, the property enjoys an enviable setting midway between the vibrant towns of Celbridge, Clane and the university town of Maynooth. Residents benefit from an excellent selection of schools, shops, restaurants, cafés and recreational amenities, all within easy reach.

For commuters, the property is exceptionally well connected. Easy access to the M4 and M7 motorways places Dublin and the wider region within convenient reach. Adding to its appeal, the Bus Éireann 120 service stops approximately 100 yards from the property and offers a direct link to Dublin City Centre, while regular rail services are available from nearby Maynooth and Sallins.

Whether you are seeking a forever family home, a peaceful countryside retreat, or a property with the flexibility to adapt to your changing needs, Clardona presents a unique opportunity to create something truly special in an exceptional location.

Properties offering such a rare combination of site size, privacy, convenience and future potential seldom come to the market. 

Viewing is strongly recommended.
